findings.evidence: 6 respondents (e.g., R0021, R0235, R0370, R0449, R0476, R0504) who scored a total of 15 were incorrectly classified as 'moderate' instead of 'severe'.
findings.description: The pipeline assigns the severity label 'moderate' to a GAD-7 total score of exactly 15, whereas according to the GAD-7 scoring guide, a total score of 15 falls at the cutoff for 'severe' (moderate is 10-14, severe is 15+).
